Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but fine. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was involved in the accident.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?
A: I was in Houston, on a multi-lane road, and I was turning left at an intersection. I had my signal on and I was
watiing for a gap in oncoming traffic.
Q: How did the other vehicle come into the picture?
A: A pickup coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my car as I was completing the turn. I
didn't see it until the impact. The light had been green for my direction, I think, but I'm not totally sure about that.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?
A: My left shoulder hit the door pretty hard. It's been sore and stiff since then. I didn't feel much at first because of the
adrenaline, but by that evening it was really bad.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment for the shoulder?
A: I went to urgent care the next day. They took X-rays and told me to rest it and follow up with an orthopedic
specialist. I have an appointment scheduled but haven't been yet.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I believe the other driver was going faster than the limit. That's my
understanding from what I saw in the mirror before the impact.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
